channel.title: Shed Industries Journal
channel.description: Honest thinking on brand positioning, market dynamics, and messaging. Published when it's worth reading.

item.title: Accept Nothing
item.description: A shed.io case study on building a website with AI: what the tool did, what stayed human, and why effort still decides the outcome.

item.title: "Brand" Is Doing Too Much Work
item.description: Why brand strategy keeps getting mistaken for design, marketing and creative direction, with examples of it working, failing and what five leading agencies do differently.

item.title: Good Is Everywhere Now. Ideas Aren't.
item.description: AI has raised the baseline of good work for everyone, fast. But it can't have the idea in the first place — the businesses that stand out are the ones supplying that spark, not waiting for AI to supply it.

item.title: I Don't Trust AI That Agrees With Me
item.description: Almost a year building a consultancy with Claude as a working partner. Why an AI that only agrees isn't saving you time — it's quietly making your judgement worse.

item.title: The Blast-Beat Guide to Brand Strategy
item.description: What Napalm Death and Dolly Parton have in common — and what it means for building a brand that lasts.

item.title: The Comfortable Danger Zone
item.description: What settled success can hide. The stage at which a particular kind of vulnerability sets in — and how to see it before it becomes a problem.

item.title: What a Brand Roadmap Actually Is
item.description: Not a vision statement. Not a set of values to frame on a wall. A clear, prioritised plan for what needs to change, what needs to stay, and in what order.
